question: Which problems exceed the total number of times they appear in the solution table when counting all occurrences, across steps 1, 2, and 3, where any non-"Stack" model's maximum test score is lower than the "Stack" model's test score for the same step and version?
sql:
WITH stack_scores AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, test_score AS stack_test_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model = 'Stack'
),
non_stack_max AS (
    SELECT name, version, step, MAX(test_score) AS max_non_stack_score
    FROM model_score
    WHERE model != 'Stack'
    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
condition_check AS (
    SELECT ns.name, ns.version, ns.step, ss.stack_test_score, ns.max_non_stack_score,
           CASE WHEN ns.max_non_stack_score < ss.stack_test_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS condition_met
    FROM non_stack_max ns
    JOIN stack_scores ss ON ns.name = ss.name AND ns.version = ss.version AND ns.step = ss.step
),
occurrence_counts AS (
    SELECT name, SUM(condition_met) AS condition_count
    FROM condition_check
    GROUP BY name
)
SELECT oc.name, oc.condition_count, s.solution_count
FROM occurrence_counts oc
JOIN (SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS solution_count FROM solution GROUP BY name) s ON oc.name = s.name
WHERE oc.condition_count > s.solution_count
ORDER BY oc.condition_count DESC
